## Definition of Done (DoD) Checklist

Please confirm that your changes satisfy the following:
- [ ] **Code Quality**: Code is clean, readable, follows guidelines, and has no linting or syntax issues.
- [ ] **Self-Review**: I have self-reviewed my own code.
- [ ] **Tests**: New unit/integration tests have been added where appropriate, and all existing tests pass.
- [ ] **Documentation**: I have updated the codebase comments, README, and/or GitHub Wiki to reflect these changes.
- [ ] **Commits**: Commits follow the **Conventional Commits** specification (e.g. `feat: ...`, `fix: ...`) so release-please can bump version and generate changelogs correctly.
